name: Orgrimmar
summary: In northern Durotar, Orgrimmar rises as the New Horde’s warrior capital. Warchief Thrall founded the city in memory of Orgrim Doomhammer, and its red canyons shelter the orcs’ renewal and survival on Kalimdor.

sections.title: A Stronghold in the Stone
sections.body: After the Third War and the victory at Mount Hyjal, Warchief Thrall brought his surviving people south to make a homeland in Durotar. Orgrimmar was built among steep mountain crags, with spiked timber walls, stone watchtowers, and caverns cut deep into the mountains. Darkspear trolls, tauren stonemasons, and goblin engineers helped raise the fortress. Its defenses turned the wilderness into a stronghold built to withstand a siege.

sections.title: Heart of the New Horde
sections.body: Free of the demonic bloodlust that once bound them, the orcs built Orgrimmar as a beacon of honor, community, and survival. Orcs and Darkspear trolls live in the city, while emissaries from the tauren of Mulgore and the newly allied Forsaken are welcomed there. Shamans teach the next generation ancestral balance, and veterans clash in gladiatorial rings to hone the army that guards Kalimdor’s fragile peace.

faq.answer: Warchief Thrall named Orgrimmar for his mentor and predecessor, the legendary orc Warchief Orgrim Doomhammer. Doomhammer fell in the Eastern Kingdoms while freeing the orc internment camps, and gave Thrall his iconic warplate and battle hammer.

Orcs, Darkspear trolls, tauren, hired goblin sappers and engineers, and the wandering champion Rexxar rapidly raised Orgrimmar. They carved and fortified its natural stone walls to provide swift, defensible shelter in Durotar’s harsh terrain.

Orcs and Sen'jin's Darkspear trolls share Orgrimmar’s districts. Tauren travelers often reside there as steadfast allies, and envoys of the recently accepted Forsaken have begun establishing a quiet foothold.
Thrall resides in Grommash Hold, a central stronghold in Orgrimmar’s Valley of Wisdom. The hold honors his fallen friend, Grom Hellscream.

angles.text: As the Horde’s supreme seat of leadership, Orgrimmar is the center for military campaigns, clan alliances, and diplomacy across Kalimdor and beyond.
For the orcs, Orgrimmar is the realization of their redemption. They cast off the demonic curse’s legacy there and build an honorable, independent future.
